tools.name: lomi_provision
tools.title: Merchant provisioning
tools.description:
Merchant provisioning. Pass required `action` to choose the REST call.

Actions:
- `create_account` — Create a merchant account (POST /provisioning/accounts). Required: body.
- `upload_document` — Upload a KYC document (POST /provisioning/merchants/{merchantId}/onboarding/documents). Required: body, merchantId.
- `extract` — Extract onboarding data (POST /provisioning/merchants/{merchantId}/onboarding/extract). Required: body, merchantId.
- `complete` — Complete merchant onboarding and submit KYC (POST /provisioning/merchants/{merchantId}/onboarding/complete). Required: body, merchantId.
- `status` — Get onboarding status (GET /provisioning/merchants/{merchantId}/onboarding/status). Required: merchantId.
- `api_keys` — Retrieve provisioned test API keys for the merchant (GET /provisioning/merchants/{merchantId}/api-keys). Required: merchantId.
- `request_live` — Request live mode activation (POST /provisioning/merchants/{merchantId}/live-activation/request). Required: body, merchantId.
- `live_status` — Get live activation request status (GET /provisioning/merchants/{merchantId}/live-activation/status). Required: merchantId.

Pass idempotency_key on write actions. Omit fields that do not apply to the chosen action.

action.description: Which REST operation to run. One of: create_account, upload_document, extract, complete, status, api_keys, request_live, live_status.

body.description: JSON request body. Required for write actions that send a body; shape depends on action.

header_Lomi-Version.description: Optional schema version pin. Echoes OpenAPI info.version (currently 1.2.0). Routes stay unversioned.

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key header (recommended on writes for safe retries).

tools.searchHint: account accounts activation api api_keys complete create_account documents extract get keys live live_status merchant merchants onboarding post provision provisioning request request_live status upload_document

create_account.title: Create a merchant account
create_account.description: Create a merchant account for agent-driven onboarding. body: email, full_name, terms_accepted_at (ISO 8601), terms_version, optional preferred_language. Leave password out: the response then includes claim_url. Send this link to the human; they set their own password there and own the account. Poll status for human_claimed. Only pass password if the human explicitly gave you one.

upload_document.title: Upload a KYC document
upload_document.description: Upload a KYC/identity document (ID, business registration, proof of address) for a merchant's onboarding. Pass the merchantId and the document; submit required documents before calling onboarding/complete.

extract.title: Extract onboarding data
extract.description: Auto-extract onboarding details from the merchant's website or uploaded documents to pre-fill their profile. Pass the merchantId; review the extracted fields before completing onboarding.

complete.title: Complete merchant onboarding and submit KYC
complete.description: Atomically creates the organization, provisions test API keys, and queues KYC review.

status.title: Get onboarding status
status.description: Return the merchant's onboarding progress plus KYC, verification state, and human_claimed. While human_claimed is false the response re-issues claim_url: send it to the human. Poll this to see what remains before calling onboarding/complete or request_live.

api_keys.title: Retrieve provisioned test API keys for the merchant
api_keys.description: Returns test secret keys and publishable keys after onboarding completes.

request_live.title: Request live mode activation
request_live.description: Ask to move the merchant from TEST to LIVE. Returns merchant_approval_path (the human approves on the dashboard) and human_claimed. If human_claimed is false, send claim_url to the human first, then merchant_approval_path. Live secret keys are never returned here; the human reads them in the dashboard.

live_status.title: Get live activation request status
live_status.description: Poll until approved. When live_keys_available is true, the merchant must retrieve the live secret key from the dashboard; not via this API.

tools.name: lomi_partners
tools.title: Partner provisioning keys
tools.description:
Partner provisioning keys. Pass required `action` to choose the REST call.

Actions:
- `mint_key` — Mint a per-user provisioning key (POST /partners/provisioning-keys). No extra required fields.
- `list_keys` — List provisioning keys minted by this partner (GET /partners/provisioning-keys). No extra required fields.
- `revoke_key` — Revoke a provisioning key (DELETE /partners/provisioning-keys/{provisioningKeyId}). Required: provisioningKeyId.
- `usage` — Partner provisioning usage summary (GET /partners/usage). No extra required fields.

Pass idempotency_key on write actions. Omit fields that do not apply to the chosen action.

action.description: Which REST operation to run. One of: mint_key, list_keys, revoke_key, usage.

header_Lomi-Version.description: Optional schema version pin. Echoes OpenAPI info.version (currently 1.2.0). Routes stay unversioned.

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key header (recommended on writes for safe retries).

tools.searchHint: account delete get keys list_keys merchant mint_key onboarding partner partners post provisioning revoke_key usage

mint_key.title: Mint a per-user provisioning key
mint_key.description: Creates a scoped lomi_prov_* key for an end user. The key can be passed to MCP or /provisioning for agent onboarding.

list_keys.title: List provisioning keys minted by this partner
list_keys.description: List provisioning keys minted by this partner
